1.c: 小—、第— (prefixes: little, ordinal)
1.d: 小 goes before a surname as a friendly way to address someone younger; 第 goes before a number to show order.
1.vi: This is the first time I've met Xiao Wang.

1.c: —们、—边 (suffixes for plural and direction)
1.d: 们 is added after pronouns or nouns for people to make them plural; 边 is added after direction words.

1.c: 上、下、里、外、前、后 (on, under, in, out, front, back)
1.d: Placed after a noun to show position: 上 on, 下 under, 里 in, 外 outside, 前 in front, 后 behind.
1.vi: The book is on the table.

1.c: 会、能、想、要、可以 (can, be able, want, need, may)
1.d: Placed before the main verb: 会 can (a learned skill), 能 be able to, 想 want to, 要 need to / will, 可以 may.

1.c: 看病、睡觉、说话、上课、下课、上班、下班、生病 (verbs that can be split)
1.d: Made of verb + object; they can be split to insert other words in the middle, and they take no further object after them.
1.zh: 我昨天睡了八个小时觉。

1.c: 多、多少、几、哪、哪儿、哪里、哪些、什么、谁、 怎么、怎么样 (how many, which, where, what, who, how…)
1.d: Used to ask questions. Put the question word right where the missing information goes; don't change the word order.

1.c: 我、你、您、他、她、我们、你们、他们、她们、 它、它们、大家 (I, you, you (polite), he, she…)
1.d: 我 I, 你 you, 您 you (polite), 他/她/它 he/she/it; add 们 for plural; 大家 everyone.

1.c: 这、那、这儿、那儿、这里、那里、这些、那些、有 的、这个、那个、有些 (this, that, here, there, these…)
1.d: 这 is near, 那 is far; 这儿/这里 here; 这些 these; 有的/有些 some.
1.zh: 这些书是我的，那些是他的。
1.vi: These books are mine, those are his.

1.c: 一、二/两、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、零、十、 百、半、千 (numbers)
1.d: 二 is used for counting and reading numbers; 两 is used before measure words; 半 means half.

1.c: 本、个、家、口、块、件、只、元、杯 (measure words for things, people, money…)
1.d: A suitable measure word must go between the number (or 这/那) and the noun.

1.c: 日、号、岁、点、分、年、天 (day, age, hour, minute…)
1.d: Used for dates, ages and times: 号 date, 岁 years old, 点 o'clock, 分 minute, 年 year, 天 day.
1.vi: I'm twenty years old this year.

1.c: 非常、很、太、真、有（一）点儿 (very, too, really, a bit…)
1.d: Placed before adjectives: 很 very, 非常 extremely, 太……了 too, 真 really, 有点儿 a bit (often negative).

1.c: 都 (all)
1.d: 都 goes before the verb and covers all the people or things mentioned before it.

1.c: 在、正在 (-ing, in progress)
1.d: 在/正在 goes before the verb to show an action in progress; 呢 is often added at the end.

1.c: 再 (again)
1.d: 再 means again, once more, for something that will be repeated.

1.c: 还、也 (also, too)
1.d: 也 means also, 还 means in addition; both go before the verb.
1.zh: 我喜欢喝茶，也喜欢喝咖啡。
1.vi: I like drinking tea, and I also like coffee.

1.c: 不、没（有）、不要 (not, did not, don't)
1.d: 不 negates the present, habits and wishes; 没(有) negates things that happened; 不要 means don't.
1.vi: I didn't go to school yesterday.

1.c: 在、和、对 (at, with, to)
1.d: Preposition + noun goes before the verb: 在 at, 和 with, 对 to / towards.
1.vi: I talk with my mom at home.

1.c: 和 (and)
1.d: 和 joins two nouns or pronouns (A 和 B); it is not used to join two clauses.

1.c: 的 (attributive particle)
1.d: Modifier + 的 + noun shows possession or a quality. With close family 的 can be dropped (我妈妈).

1.c: 了 (completion / change particle)
1.d: 了 after a verb shows a completed action; 了 at the end of a sentence shows a change.
1.vi: I bought a set of clothes.

1.c: 吧、吗、呢 (sentence-final particles)
1.d: 吗 asks yes/no; 呢 asks back "and what about…"; 吧 makes a suggestion or guess.

1.c: 喂 (hey, hello)
1.d: 喂 is used when answering or making a phone call, or to call someone: hello, hey.

1.c: 联合短语 (coordinate phrase), 偏正短语 (modifier–head phrase), 动宾短语 (verb–object phrase), 主谓短语 (subject–predicate phrase)
1.d: Coordinate (A 和 B), modifier–head (modifier + noun), verb–object (verb + object), subject–predicate (subject + predicate).

1.c: 数量短语 (number–measure phrase), 介宾短语 (preposition–object phrase), 方 位短语 (locative phrase)
1.d: Number–measure (两个), preposition–object (在家), locative (房间里).
1.vi: Two children are in the room.

1.c: 主语 (subject)、谓语 (predicate)、宾语 (object)、定语 (attributive)、状语 (adverbial)、补语（动量补语 – complement of frequency）
1.d: A sentence has a subject, predicate and object; attributives go before nouns, adverbials before verbs, and frequency complements after verbs.
1.zh: 我的朋友昨天来了两次。

1.c: 陈述句 (declarative)、疑问句 (interrogative)、祈使句 (imperative)、感叹句 (exclamatory)
1.d: Declarative (telling), interrogative (asking), imperative (inviting, requesting), exclamatory (expressing feelings).
1.vi: Please sit down! It's so beautiful here!

1.c: “是”字句 (是 sentence)、 “有”字句 (有 sentence)、存现 句 (existential sentence)、连动句 (serial verb sentence)、双宾语句 (double object sentence)
1.d: 是 sentence (A is B), 有 sentence (have / there is), existential sentence (place + 有 + person/thing), serial verbs (two verbs in a row), double object (give someone something).
1.vi: There is a book on the table.

1.c: ……，也……；……，还…… (compound sentences without conjunctions)
1.d: Two clauses side by side with no conjunction; the second uses 也 (also) or 还 (in addition).
1.zh: 他会说汉语，还会写汉字。
1.vi: He can speak Chinese, and he can also write characters.

1.c: 完成态 (completed)、变化态 (change)、进行态 (in progress)
1.d: Completed: verb + 了; change: 了 at the end; in progress: 在/正在 + verb (+ 呢).

1.c: 钱数表示法 (saying amounts of money)、序数表达法：第+数词 (ordinal numbers)
1.d: Money: number + 块/元 (+ 毛); ordinals: 第 + number.
1.vi: This apple costs three and a half yuan.

1.c: 年、月、日、星期；钟点表示法 (dates and clock times)
1.d: Go from big to small: year 年, month 月, day 号/日, weekday 星期; time: 点 + 分.
1.zh: 今天是五月一号，星期三。

2.d: 面 follows direction words: 前面, 后面, 上面, 里面, 外面.
2.vi: The supermarket is behind the school.

2.d: 左 left, 右 right; usually said as 左边/右边.
2.vi: The bank is on your left.

2.d: Repeating a verb softens it ("try, a little"): AA 看看, A一A 看一看, A了A 看了看, ABAB 休息休息.
2.vi: Take a little rest.

2.d: 可能 + verb: may, probably (a guess).
2.vi: It may rain tomorrow.

2.c: 帮忙、游泳、跳舞、跑步 (verbs that can be split)
2.d: 帮忙、游泳、跳舞、跑步 can be split: 帮他的忙, 游了一个小时泳.
2.vi: Can you do me a favour?

2.d: 为什么 asks for a reason (why); answer with 因为.
2.vi: Why are you unhappy?

2.d: 自己 means oneself, by oneself; it can follow a pronoun: 我自己.
2.vi: I'll do this myself.

2.c: 那么、那样、这么、这样、每 (so, like this, every)
2.d: 这么/那么 + adjective: this/that much; 这样/那样: this/that way; 每 + measure word: every.
2.vi: I'm this busy every day.

2.d: Repeating adjectives as AA (高高的) or AABB (高高兴兴) makes them stronger and more vivid; don't add 很.
2.zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地去学校。
2.vi: The children happily go to school.

2.c: 万、好多、多 (ten thousand, many, lots)
2.d: 万 is ten thousand; number + 多 means more than (十多个); 好多 means a lot.
2.vi: There are lots of people here.

2.c: 条、位、间、名、包 (specific and borrowed measure words)
2.d: 条 long things (roads, fish, trousers), 位 people (polite), 间 rooms, 名 people (formal), 包 packets.
2.vi: There are three guests at my home.

2.d: Verb + number + 次: how many times you do something.
2.vi: I've been to Beijing twice.

2.d: 多 + adjective: how (very); 好 + adjective: so, really; 最: most.
2.vi: He is the tallest in my class.

2.d: 一起 + verb: together; often used with 和/跟.
2.vi: Let's go and eat together.

2.c: 还、已经、有时（候）、快、快要、正 (still, already, sometimes, soon, right now)
2.d: 已经……了 already; 快/快要……了 about to; 正 right now; 有时(候) sometimes; 还 still.
2.vi: I've already eaten.

2.d: 常/经常 goes before the verb: often, frequently.
2.vi: I often go to the library to read.

2.d: 别 + verb: don't (advice or command), like 不要.
2.vi: Stop talking, the teacher is here.

2.d: 再: (do A) and then (B); 就: then, right away (linking two actions in a row).
2.vi: Eat first, then go.

2.c: 都、就、还是 (already, exactly, had better)
2.d: 都 stresses "already"; 就 stresses "exactly, precisely"; 还是 means "had better, still".
2.vi: It's already 12 o'clock, go to bed.

2.d: 从 + time/place: from; often used with 到.
2.vi: I work from 8 to 5.

2.d: 往 + direction: towards; 从 + place: through, from.
2.vi: Go straight ahead and you'll get there.

2.d: 给 + person: to/for someone; 比: A 比 B + adjective (comparison); 跟 + person: with someone.
2.vi: He is taller than me.

2.d: 因为 + reason: because.
2.vi: Because it was raining, I didn't go out.

2.d: 跟 joins two nouns: A 跟 B means A and B.
2.vi: He and I are both Vietnamese.

2.c: 但、但是、那、虽然、还是、因为、所以 (but, although, or, because… so…)
2.d: 虽然……但是 although… (but); 因为……所以 because… so; 还是 or (in choice questions); 那 then, in that case.
2.zh: 虽然很累，但是我很高兴。
2.vi: Although I'm very tired, I'm very happy.

2.d: 得 links a verb to its complement (跑得很快); 地 links an adverbial to a verb (认真地学习).
2.vi: He runs very fast.

2.d: 过 after a verb: have done before; 着 after a verb: ongoing, a lasting state.
2.vi: I have been to China.

2.d: 呢 ongoing / asking back; 吧 suggestion; 的 affirmation; 啊 exclamation, softens the sentence.
2.vi: The scenery here is really beautiful!

2.c: “的”字短语 (的 phrase)、连谓短语 (serial predicate phrase)、兼语短语 (pivotal phrase)
2.d: A 的 phrase replaces a noun (红的); serial predicate (去商店买东西); pivotal phrase (请他来).
2.zh: 红的是我的，白的是你的。
2.vi: The red one is mine, the white one is yours.

2.c: 名词性短语、动词性短语、形容词性短语 (noun / verb / adjective phrases)
2.d: Noun phrases (我的书), verb phrases (看电影) and adjective phrases (非常好) act like a single word in the sentence.
2.vi: Watching films is my hobby.

2.d: 什么的 goes at the end of a list: and so on, etc.
2.zh: 我买了苹果、香蕉什么的。
2.vi: I bought apples, bananas and so on.

2.c: 还是……吧 (you'd better…)、要/快要/就要……了 (about to…)、都……了 (already…)
2.d: 还是……吧 you'd better… (suggestion); 要/快要/就要……了 about to…; 都……了 already….
2.vi: The train is about to leave.

2.c: 受事主语 (subject that receives the action)
2.d: The thing affected by the action comes first as the subject, without 被.
2.vi: The homework is finished.

2.c: 名词性短语作谓语 (noun phrase as predicate)
2.d: A noun phrase (date, age, hometown, price) can be the predicate without 是.
2.vi: Today is Saturday.

2.c: 动词/动词性短语/主谓短语作定语 (verbs and subject–predicate phrases as attributives)
2.d: Verb, verb phrase or subject–predicate phrase + 的 + noun.
2.vi: This is the book I bought yesterday.

2.d: Verb + 错/懂/好/会/完: tells the result of the action.
2.vi: Did you understand?

2.c: 来/去；上、下、进、出、过、回；出来/进去/起 来… (direction complements)
2.d: Verb + 来/去 (towards / away from the speaker); + 上/下/进/出/过/回 (+ 来/去).
2.vi: He came out of the classroom.

2.c: 动词+得+形容词性短语 (state complement)
2.d: Verb + 得 + adjective phrase: comments on how something is done.
2.vi: She writes Chinese characters beautifully.

2.c: Duration of an action; adjective + quantity
2.d: Verb + duration (学了两年); adjective + quantity (大两岁).
2.vi: I've studied Chinese for two years.

2.d: The predicate is itself a subject–predicate phrase.
2.vi: He is in very good health.

2.c: 用“还是”的选择问句 (choice questions with 还 是)
2.d: A 还是 B？ asks for a choice: A or B.
2.vi: Would you like tea or coffee?

2.c: 用“别”的祈使句 (commands with 别)
2.d: 别 + verb (+ 了): don't…
2.vi: Don't forget your phone.

2.c: “是”字句 (explanation / feature)、 “有”字句 (degree reached)、存现句、比较句、“是……的”句
2.d: 是 explains; 有 shows degree (有他那么高); existential sentences; comparisons with 比; 是……的 stresses time, place or manner.
2.vi: I came by plane.

2.c: 选择复句、转折复句、因果复句、紧缩复句
2.d: Choice (还是/或者), contrast (但是), cause and effect (因为……所以), contracted (一……就……).
2.zh: 因为太晚了，所以我坐出租车回家。
2.vi: It was too late, so I took a taxi home.

2.d: Verb + 着: a lasting state; verb + 过: have experienced.
2.vi: The door is open.

2.c: 序数表示法：数词+量词；概数表达法 (approximate numbers)
2.d: Ordinals: number + measure word (二楼, 三号); approximations: 两三个, 十几个.
2.vi: There are a dozen or so students in the class.

3.d: 老 + surname or birth order: a friendly way to address someone you've known long (老王), second child (老二).
3.vi: Lao Wang is my close friend.

3.d: 家 for an expert (作家), 子 noun suffix (桌子), 员 for staff or a member (服务员).
3.vi: She wants to be a writer.

3.c: 东、南、西、北、北方、东方、南方、西方、中 间 (east, south, west, north, middle…)
3.d: 东、南、西、北 east, south, west, north; 中间 in the middle.
3.vi: My home is in the east of the city.

3.c: 需要、该、应该、愿意、得 (need, should, must, be willing)
3.d: 需要 need; 应该/该 should; 愿意 be willing; 得 (děi) must.
3.vi: You should rest more.

3.c: 动宾式：放假、见面、结婚、洗澡；动补式：离 开、完成、分开 (separable verbs)
3.d: Verb–object (放假, 见面, 结婚, 洗澡) and verb–complement (离开, 完成) types can be split: 见过面, 洗了个澡.
3.vi: Let's meet tomorrow.

3.d: 怎样 means how, like 怎么样; asks about manner or condition.
3.vi: How is this dish made?

3.c: 任指：疑问代词+都；疑问代词+疑问代词；不定指 (indefinite reference)
3.d: Question word + 都/也: everyone/everything (谁都知道); two matching question words (谁…谁…); or something unspecified (吃点儿什么).
3.vi: Everyone knows this.

3.d: 别人 other people; 咱们 we (including the listener).
3.vi: Let's go together.

3.d: 别的/其他 + noun: other, the others.
3.vi: Do you have any other questions?

3.c: 把、双、张、种、层、封、页、辆、节、所、 班、段、头、句；公斤、斤、角、毛、刻、米
3.d: 把 things with a handle (chair, umbrella), 双 pair, 张 flat things, 种 kind, 辆 vehicles, 公斤/斤 kilo / jin, 米 metre…
3.zh: 我买了一双鞋和两张票。
3.vi: I bought a pair of shoes and two tickets.

3.d: Containers borrowed as measure words: 一碗饭, 一盘菜.
3.vi: I ate two bowls of rice.

3.d: 口 mouthful, 回 time, 遍 time (from start to finish), 声 sound.
3.vi: I've read this book three times.

3.d: Repeated measure words (个个, 张张): every single one….
3.vi: Every one of them is very hardworking.

3.c: 比较、还、更、特别、挺、有些、越、极 (fairly, even more, very…)
3.d: 比较 fairly; 更 even more; 特别 especially; 挺……的 quite; 越 the more; 极 extremely.
3.vi: Today is colder than yesterday.

3.c: 就、一块儿、一共、只、到处、只是
3.d: 就/只 only; 一共 in total; 一块儿 together; 到处 everywhere; 只是 merely.
3.vi: How much is it altogether?

3.c: 才、马上、先、一会儿、刚、刚刚、一直
3.d: 才 only then; 马上 right away; 先 first; 一会儿 in a moment; 刚/刚刚 just now; 一直 all along, straight.
3.zh: 我刚到家，马上给你打电话。
3.vi: I just got home, I'll call you right away.

3.d: 总/总是 always; 又 again (already happened); 常常 often.
3.vi: He was late again yesterday.

3.d: 一边 A 一边 B: do A while doing B (two things at once).
3.zh: 他一边吃饭一边看手机。
3.vi: He eats while looking at his phone.

3.c: 大概、必须、差不多、一定、好像、几乎
3.d: 大概 probably; 必须 must; 差不多 almost; 一定 definitely; 好像 seem; 几乎 nearly.
3.vi: He seems to be ill.

3.d: 当然 of course; 其实 actually; 终于 finally; 才/就 add emphasis.
3.vi: I finally found a job.

3.d: 不必/不用 + verb: no need to.
3.vi: You don't need to worry.

3.d: 为 for someone; 向 towards someone; 关于 about (a topic).
3.zh: 这是一本关于中国历史的书。
3.vi: This is a book about Chinese history.

3.d: 向 + direction: towards.
3.vi: Go towards the left.

3.d: 为了 + purpose: in order to; 为 + cause/purpose.
3.zh: 为了学好汉语，他每天练习。
3.vi: To learn Chinese well, he practises every day.

3.d: 把 brings the object before the verb to say what is done to it; 被 is used in passive sentences.
3.vi: I've finished my homework.

3.d: 根据 + basis: according to.
3.zh: 根据天气预报，明天有雨。
3.vi: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.

3.d: 或/或者 joins possibilities in statements: or.
3.zh: 你可以坐地铁或者打车去。
3.vi: You can take the subway or a taxi.

3.c: 只有、只要、不但、而且、如果、可、可是、然 后
3.d: 只要……就 as long as… then; 只有……才 only if… then; 不但……而且 not only… but also; 如果……就 if… then; 可(是) but; 然后 then, afterwards.
3.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
3.vi: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

3.d: ……的话 goes at the end of the "if" clause: if….
3.zh: 有时间的话，来我家玩吧。
3.vi: If you have time, come over to my place.

3.c: 同位短语 (appositive phrase)、动补短语 (verb–complement phrase)、数量重叠
3.d: Appositive (我们大家), verb–complement (洗干净), repeated number–measure (一个一个).
3.zh: 请你们一个一个地进来。
3.vi: Please come in one by one.

3.c: 不A不 B (neither this nor that)
3.d: 不A不B: neither A nor B (just right), or a firm promise (不见不散).
3.zh: 这件衣服不大不小，正合适。
3.vi: These clothes are neither too big nor too small, they fit just right.

3.c: 不一会儿、看来、在……看来、越来越、看起 来、看上去、一般来说、不怎么样
3.d: 越来越 more and more; 看起来/看上去 looks like; 在……看来 in…'s view; 一般来说 generally speaking; 不怎么样 not great.
3.vi: The weather is getting colder and colder.

3.c: 除了……（以外）……还/也/都……；从…… 起；对……来说；一……也/都不……；一点儿 也不；越……越……；……以前/以后；X什么； 该……了；在……上/下/中
3.d: 除了……(以外)，还/也/都 besides / except…; 对……来说 for…; 越……越 the more… the more; 一点儿也不 not… at all; 该……了 it's time to….
3.zh: 除了汉语以外，我还学英语。
3.vi: Besides Chinese, I also study English.

3.c: Verbs / adjectives / subject–predicate phrases as subjects
3.d: A verb, adjective or subject–predicate phrase can be the subject.
3.vi: Learning Chinese is very interesting.

3.d: Order of several attributives: possessor, demonstrative, number, quality, then the noun.
3.zh: 我的那两本新书在桌子上。
3.vi: Those two new books of mine are on the table.

3.d: Verb + 到 (reach, manage), 住 (hold firmly), 走 (away), 上 (close, reach).
3.vi: I found the key.

3.d: Extended meanings: 起来 start (笑起来), 下去 continue (说下去), 出来 work out, notice (看出来).
3.zh: 听了这个故事，大家都笑起来了。
3.vi: Hearing this story, everyone burst out laughing.

3.d: Verb + 得/不 + complement: can / can't manage to.
3.zh: 黑板上的字你看得清楚吗？
3.vi: Can you see the words on the board clearly?

3.d: Adjective + 得很 / 极了 / 坏了: extremely.
3.vi: It's extremely hot today.

3.c: Time elapsed since an action ended
3.d: Verb + time + 了: how long ago the action ended.
3.vi: It's been three years since he graduated from university.

3.d: 怎样 + verb: asks how to do something.
3.vi: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

3.d: 不是……吗？ is a rhetorical question for emphasis: isn't it…?
3.vi: Don't you like dumplings?

3.c: 把字句、被动句、连动句、比较句、存现句、 “是……的”句、重动句
3.d: 把 sentences, 被 passives, serial verbs, comparisons, existential sentences, 是……的 sentences, verb-repeating sentences (说汉语说得很好).
3.zh: 我的自行车被弟弟骑走了。
3.vi: My bike was ridden off by my younger brother.

3.c: 承接、选择、并列、递进、转折、假设、条件、 目的、紧缩复句
3.d: Sequence (先……然后), choice, parallel, progression (不但……而且), contrast (可是), supposition (如果), condition (只要), purpose (为了), contracted.
3.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且说得很好。
3.vi: Not only can he speak Chinese, he speaks it very well.

3.d: Approximations: 大概 + number; two neighbouring numbers (三四个, 七八天).
3.zh: 我大概等了二三十分钟。
3.vi: I waited about twenty or thirty minutes.

4.d: 敢 + verb: dare to.
4.zh: 他不敢一个人走夜路。
4.vi: He doesn't dare walk alone at night.

4.d: 各 each, every; 各位 everyone (polite); 各种 all kinds; 任何 any; 此 this (written).
4.zh: 各位朋友，欢迎来到这里。
4.vi: Everyone, welcome.

4.c: （1）专用名量词：打、袋、棵、台、幅；（2）借 用名量词：脸、手、盒、屋子、桌子
4.d: Specific: 打 dozen, 袋 bag, 棵 tree, 台 machine, 幅 picture; borrowed: 一脸, 一手, 一盒, 一屋子, 一桌子 (a whole… full).
4.zh: 墙上挂着一幅画。
4.vi: A painting hangs on the wall.

4.d: 场 match, show; 顿 meal, bout (of scolding); 趟 trip (there and back).
4.zh: 我去了一趟超市。
4.vi: I made a trip to the supermarket.

4.c: 十分、更加、稍、稍微、尤其、多么
4.d: 十分 very; 更加 even more; 稍(微) slightly; 尤其 especially; 多么 how (very).
4.zh: 我喜欢运动，尤其是游泳。
4.vi: I like sports, especially swimming.

4.d: 共 in total; 全 whole; 光/仅/仅仅 only; 至少 at least.
4.zh: 这件事至少需要三天。
4.vi: This will take at least three days.

4.c: 按时、从来、赶紧、赶快、已、忽然、将、将 要、从、本来
4.d: 按时 on time; 从来 always (so far); 赶紧/赶快 hurry; 已 already; 忽然 suddenly; 将/将要 will, about to; 本来 originally.
4.zh: 他从来不迟到。
4.vi: He has never been late.

4.d: 重新 again from scratch; 往往 usually (as a pattern); 偶尔 occasionally; 再次 once again; 老 keep on.
4.zh: 写错了，你重新写一遍吧。
4.vi: That's wrong, write it again.

4.d: 故意 on purpose; 互相/相互 each other.
4.zh: 同学们应该互相帮助。
4.vi: Classmates should help each other.

4.d: 却 goes after the subject, before the verb: but, yet (contrary to expectation).
4.zh: 他很努力，成绩却不好。
4.vi: He works hard, yet his results aren't good.

4.d: 也许 maybe; 恐怕 I'm afraid (worry about something bad).
4.zh: 恐怕今天他来不了了。
4.vi: I'm afraid he can't come today.

4.c: 才4、就 5、并1、还4、竟然、究竟、正好、到 底、难道、千万、确实、只好、差（一）点儿
4.d: 并 + negative: not at all; 竟然 unexpectedly; 究竟/到底 after all, on earth; 难道 could it be; 千万 be sure to (warning); 确实 indeed; 只好 have no choice but; 差(一)点儿 almost.
4.zh: 我差点儿忘了你的生日。
4.vi: I almost forgot your birthday.

4.d: 自 from; 当……的时候 when; 由 from (a place); 随着 along with; 等 wait until.
4.zh: 随着经济的发展，人们的生活越来越好。
4.vi: Along with economic growth, people's lives keep getting better.

4.d: 将 like 把 (written); 由 done by someone; 叫/让 like 被 (spoken).
4.zh: 这件事由我来负责。
4.vi: I'm in charge of this.

4.d: 由于 + cause: due to, because (formal).
4.zh: 由于天气不好，比赛推迟了。
4.vi: Due to bad weather, the match was postponed.

4.d: 对于 regarding (a topic); 与 with, and (written).
4.zh: 对于这个问题，大家有不同的看法。
4.vi: People have different views on this issue.

4.d: 作为 as (in the role of); 按/按照 according to.
4.zh: 请按照要求完成作业。
4.vi: Please finish the exercise as required.

4.d: 并 and (joins verbs); 而 and yet, and (joins adjectives); 与 and (joins nouns, formal).
4.zh: 这个办法简单而有效。
4.vi: This method is simple and effective.

4.c: 此外、而 2、既然、甚至、不过、并且、不光、 不仅、另外、要是、因此、由于 2、加上
4.d: 此外 besides; 而 but; 既然 since; 甚至 even; 不过 but; 并且 moreover; 不仅/不光 not only; 另外 in addition; 要是 if; 因此 therefore; 加上 on top of that.
4.zh: 既然你不舒服，就早点儿回家吧。
4.vi: Since you're not feeling well, go home early.

4.d: 等 etc.; 者 person (读者); 之 of (written); 就是 that's all (emphasis).
4.zh: 我们买了苹果、香蕉等水果。
4.vi: We bought apples, bananas and other fruit.

4.d: 啊 shows surprise or asks back; 嗯 uh-huh, yes (agreeing).
4.zh: 嗯，我明白了。
4.vi: Mm, I understand.

4.d: Insert an adjective 大/小/满… between the number and measure word: 一大碗, 一小块.
4.zh: 他一口气吃了一大碗面条。
4.vi: He ate a big bowl of noodles in one go.

4.d: 一A一B (一心一意), 无A无B (无忧无虑), 有A有B (有说有笑).
4.zh: 他们一路上有说有笑。
4.vi: They chatted and laughed all the way.

4.c: 来得及/来不及、有的是、说不定、不怎么、就是 说/这就是说
4.d: 来得及/来不及 there's time / no time; 有的是 plenty of; 说不定 maybe; 不怎么 not very; 就是说 that is to say.
4.zh: 快走吧，要不然来不及了。
4.vi: Hurry up, or we won't make it.

4.c: 一+量词+比+一+量词；在……方面；够……的； 拿……来说；再也不/没……；怎么都/也+不/ 没……；为了……而……；动词+一X是一X； （没）有什么（好）X的；X是X，Y是Y；X 也得X，不 X也得X；X就是了；还 X呢；你 X 你的吧；让/叫你X你就X；说什么/怎么（着） 也得X；X就X（点儿）吧；X是 X
4.d: 一 + measure word + 比 + 一 + measure word: more… by the day; 在……方面 in terms of…; 拿……来说 take… for example; 再也不/没 never… again; 为了……而 for the sake of… (do).
4.zh: 他的汉语一天比一天好。
4.vi: His Chinese is getting better by the day.

4.c: 形容词/心理动词+死了/厉害
4.d: Adjective / emotion verb + 死了/厉害: extremely (spoken).
4.zh: 今天累死了。
4.vi: I'm dead tired today.

4.d: Verb + 得了/不了 (liǎo): can / can't manage.
4.zh: 这么多菜，我一个人吃不了。
4.vi: There are so many dishes, I can't finish them alone.

4.c: 难道……吗？；由疑问代词构成的反问句
4.d: 难道……吗？ could it be that…?; or a question word used rhetorically (谁不知道？ = everyone knows).
4.zh: 难道你不知道吗？
4.vi: Don't tell me you didn't know?

4.d: 把 + object + verb + 在/到/给/成…: put at, move to, give to, turn into.
4.zh: 请把书放在桌子上。
4.vi: Please put the book on the table.

4.c: 被动句2：主语+叫/让+宾语+动词+其他成分
4.d: Subject + 叫/让 + doer + verb + other elements (spoken; the doer must be stated).
4.zh: 我的蛋糕让弟弟吃了。
4.vi: My cake was eaten by my younger brother.

4.c: 兼语句2 (liking or disliking / naming / causing)
4.d: Verbs of liking or disliking (喜欢, 讨厌), naming (叫, 选), causing (让, 使) + person + action/quality.
4.zh: 妈妈让我早点儿回家。
4.vi: Mom told me to come home a bit earlier.

4.d: A 不如 B: A is not as good as B; 跟……相比: compared with….
4.zh: 我的汉语不如他好。
4.vi: My Chinese isn't as good as his.

4.d: A double negative gives a stronger positive: 不能不, 没有……不.
4.zh: 这个问题我们不能不考虑。
4.vi: We have to consider this problem.

4.c: 不是……，而是……；既……，又/也……；一方 面……，另一方面……
4.d: 不是A，而是B not A but B; 既……又/也 both… and…; 一方面……另一方面…… on one hand… on the other hand….
4.zh: 她既聪明又漂亮。
4.vi: She is both smart and pretty.

4.d: 首先……其次/然后 first… then; ……于是…… so, thereupon.
4.zh: 首先要准备材料，然后再开会。
4.vi: First prepare the documents, then hold the meeting.

4.c: ……甚至……；不仅/不光……还/而且……； 连……也/都……
4.d: 甚至 even; 不仅/不光……还/而且 not only… but also; 连……也/都 even….
4.zh: 这个字连老师都不认识。
4.vi: Even the teacher doesn't know this character.

4.d: 不是A，就是B: if not A then B (only two possibilities).
4.zh: 周末他不是看书，就是睡觉。
4.vi: At weekends he's either reading or sleeping.

4.c: 尽管……但是/可是……；……然而……；……不 过……
4.d: 尽管……但是/可是 although… (still); 然而 however; 不过 but, only.
4.zh: 尽管很累，但是他还在工作。
4.vi: Although very tired, he is still working.

4.d: 要是……就 if… then; ……否则 otherwise.
4.zh: 你快点儿，否则就迟到了。
4.vi: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.

4.d: 不管/无论……都/也: no matter… still.
4.zh: 无论多忙，他每天都运动。
4.vi: No matter how busy he is, he exercises every day.

4.d: 既然……就 since… then; (由于)……因此 due to… therefore.
4.zh: 由于下大雨，因此比赛取消了。
4.vi: Because of the heavy rain, the match was cancelled.

4.d: The second clause uses 好: so that (it's easy to).
4.zh: 你留个电话，我好联系你。
4.vi: Leave your phone number so I can contact you.

4.d: 即使/就是……也: even if… still.
4.zh: 即使下雨，我也要去。
4.vi: Even if it rains, I have to go.

4.d: Contracted sentences without conjunctions, or 不……也……: even without… still….
4.zh: 你不说我也知道。
4.vi: Even if you don't say it, I know.

4.c: 概数表示法 3：数词+来+量词；大约/左右/前后； 小数、分数、百分数、倍数
4.d: Number + 来 + measure word (十来个: about ten); 大约/左右/前后: about; decimals (点), fractions (分之), percentages (百分之), multiples (倍).
4.zh: 这次考试有百分之八十的人通过了。
4.vi: 80% of people passed this exam.

5.d: 头 as a noun suffix (neutral tone): 石头, 木头, 念头; or something worth doing: 看头, 吃头.
5.vi: This film isn't worth watching.

5.d: 彼此 each other; 如此 so, like this; 本 this, one's own (本校, 本人).
5.vi: We understand each other well.

5.c: 册、朵、届、颗、匹、行、架、群、支、根、批、束、 副、集、周
5.d: 册 volume, 朵 flower, 届 session/year, 颗 grain/piece, 匹 (horse), 行 row, 架 (plane), 群 group/flock, 支 stick/team, 根 strand, 批 batch, 束 bunch, 副 pair/set, 集 episode, 周 week.
5.vi: He gave me a bunch of flowers.

5.d: 看 + 一眼: take a look.
5.vi: He glanced at me.

5.c: 过于、相当、较 1、可2、格外、极其
5.d: 过于 overly; 相当 quite; 较 relatively; 可 really (emphasis); 格外 especially; 极其 extremely.
5.vi: The moon is especially round tonight.

5.c: 时刻、曾经、立刻、连忙、始终、早已、即将、急忙、 渐渐、尽快、早晚
5.d: 时刻 at all times; 曾经 once (in the past); 立刻 immediately; 连忙/急忙 hurriedly; 始终 from start to finish; 早已 long since; 即将 about to; 渐渐 gradually; 尽快 as soon as possible; 早晚 sooner or later.
5.vi: It's gradually getting dark.

5.d: 老是 always (annoyingly); 通常 usually; 时常 often.
5.vi: I usually get up at 7.

5.d: 尽量 as much as possible; 亲自 in person.
5.vi: The principal came to visit us in person.

5.d: 便 like 就 (written); 一旦 once.
5.zh: 一旦决定了，就不要放弃。
5.vi: Once you've decided, don't give up.

5.d: 似乎 seemingly; 仿佛 as if (written).
5.vi: He doesn't seem very happy.

5.c: 毕竟、居然、反正、根本、果然、简直、绝对、的确、 反而、白、刚好、可 3
5.d: 毕竟 after all; 居然 unexpectedly; 反正 anyway; 根本 (not) at all; 果然 sure enough; 简直 simply; 绝对 absolutely; 的确 indeed; 反而 on the contrary; 白 in vain; 刚好 just right.
5.vi: After all, he's still a child.

5.d: 自从 + a point in the past (+ 以后/以来): ever since.
5.zh: 自从来了中国，他每天说汉语。
5.vi: Ever since he came to China, he has spoken Chinese every day.

5.d: 朝 towards; 沿(着) along.
5.vi: We took a walk along the river.

5.d: 替 on behalf of; 同 with (like 跟); 较 compared with (like 比, written).
5.vi: Please send him my regards.

5.d: 凭 rely on; 据 according to (据说); 依据 on the basis of.
5.vi: I hear there will be heavy snow tomorrow.

5.d: 以及 and, as well as (joining several nouns, formal); 同 and.
5.zh: 桌子上有书、本子以及笔。
5.vi: There are books, notebooks and pens on the table.

5.d: 从而 thus; 可见 it is clear that; 假如 supposing; 总之 in short.
5.zh: 总之，我们明天必须完成。
5.vi: In short, we must finish tomorrow.

5.d: 像……似的: just like…
5.zh: 她高兴得像个孩子似的。
5.vi: She's as happy as a child.

5.c: A来A去、A着 A着、没 A没B、说A就A
5.d: A来A去 (back and forth), A着A着 (while… suddenly), 没A没B, 说A就A (no sooner said than done).
5.vi: He said he'd go, and off he went.

5.c: 不得了、用不着、从……来看、A的A，B的B、 （自）……以来、由……组成、X也不是，Y也不是、 X也X不得，Y也Y不得
5.d: 不得了 terrible, extremely; 用不着 no need; 从……来看 judging from…; (自)……以来 since… until now; 由……组成 made up of….
5.zh: 我们班由三十个学生组成。
5.vi: Our class is made up of thirty students.

5.c: X是它，Y也是它；X着也是X着；不管怎样说；真有 你/他/她的；X什么X；什么X不X（的）；不 X白不 X；X来X去，都是/就是……；动词+什么（就）是什 么
5.d: X什么X: no need to X; 不X白不X: it'd be a waste not to X; X来X去: keep X-ing; verb + 什么(就)是什么: whatever you like.
5.vi: Stop crying, just say what's wrong properly.

5.d: Order of several adverbials: time, place/target, manner, then the verb.
5.zh: 他昨天在图书馆认真地看了一下午书。
5.vi: Yesterday he read attentively in the library all afternoon.

5.d: Verb + 得/不得: may / must not (forbidden or inadvisable).
5.vi: You mustn't eat this.

5.c: 形容词/心理动词+得+不得了
5.d: Adjective / emotion verb + 得不得了: extremely.
5.zh: 听到这个消息，他高兴得不得了。
5.vi: Hearing the news, he was happier than words can say.

5.c: 趋向补语3：表示状态意义：动词/形容词+下来/下去/起 来/过来/过去
5.d: State meanings: 下来 (settle down), 下去 (carry on), 起来 (start, increase), 过来 (come back to normal), 过去 (lose a state).
5.vi: The weather is gradually warming up.

5.c: （1）动词/形容词+得+动词短语；（2）动词/形容词+得 +主谓短语；（3）动词/形容词+得+固定短语
5.d: Verb/adjective + 得 + verb phrase / subject–predicate phrase / fixed phrase: so… that….
5.vi: He was so tired he couldn't get up.

5.c: 有字句3：（1）主语+有+着+宾语；（2）主语+动词+有+ 宾语
5.d: Subject + 有着 + object (formal); subject + verb + 有 + object (写有, 留有).
5.zh: 这座城市有着悠久的历史。
5.vi: This city has a long history.

5.c: 把字句3：（1）主语+把+宾语+一+动词；（2）主语+把+ 宾语1+动词+宾语 2
5.d: 把 + object + 一 + verb (a quick, decisive action); 把 + object 1 + verb + object 2.
5.vi: He slammed the door and left.

5.c: 连动句3：前后两个动词性词语具有因果、转折、条件 关系
5.d: Two verbs in a row linked by cause and effect, contrast or condition.
5.vi: He's ill, so he can't go to work.

5.c: 比较句4：A+形容词+B+数量补语
5.d: A + adjective + B + quantity: A is more… than B by how much.
5.vi: My older brother is three years older than me.

5.c: 被动句3：主语+被/叫/让+宾语+给+动词+其他成分
5.d: Subject + 被/叫/让 + doer + 给 + verb + other elements.
5.vi: The cup was broken by him.

5.d: ……，便……: then, right away (written).
5.vi: He went out as soon as he finished eating.

5.d: 或是……，或是……: either… or…
5.zh: 周末我或是看书，或是去跑步。
5.vi: At weekends I either read or go for a run.

5.d: 一旦……就 once; 假如……(就) supposing; 万一……(就) in case; 要不然/不然 otherwise.
5.zh: 万一下雨，我们就在家看电影。
5.vi: In case it rains, we'll stay home and watch a film.

5.d: ……，因而…… therefore; ……，可见…… it is clear that.
5.zh: 他每天都练习，可见他很想学好。
5.vi: He practises every day, which shows how much he wants to do well.

5.d: 哪怕……，也……: even if… still.
5.zh: 哪怕再难，我也不会放弃。
5.vi: No matter how hard it is, I won't give up.

5.c: 不但不/不但没有……，反而……；不是……，还/还 是……
5.d: 不但不/不但没有……，反而…… not only not… but instead; 不是……，还/还是……
5.zh: 吃了药，他的病不但没好，反而更重了。
5.vi: After taking the medicine, his illness didn't get better; it got worse.

5.d: ……，为的是……: in order to…
5.zh: 他每天早起，为的是锻炼身体。
5.vi: He gets up early every day in order to keep fit.

5.d: 没有……就没有 without… there would be no…; 不……不…… if not… then not; 再……也…… no matter how… still.
5.zh: 没有你的帮助，就没有我的今天。
5.vi: Without your help, I wouldn't be where I am today.

6.d: 超 super-, 多 multi-, 反 anti-, 无 without, 亚 sub-, 准 quasi-/to-be: form new words (超市, 无线, 准妈妈).
6.zh: 这款手机支持无线充电。
6.vi: This phone supports wireless charging.

6.d: 化 -ise, 式 style, 型 type, 性 -ness: 现代化, 中式, 大型, 重要性.
6.zh: 我们要认识到这件事的重要性。
6.vi: We need to realise how important this is.

6.d: 人家: other people, or "little me" when speaking coyly.
6.zh: 人家都准备好了，你还没起床。
6.vi: I'm all ready, and you're still not up.

6.d: 串 bunch/string, 滴 drop, 枝 branch, 扇 (door/window) leaf, 卷 roll / volume.
6.vi: He bought a bunch of grapes.

6.d: 番: time, turn; often 一番 (a while, thoroughly).
6.vi: He thought it over carefully.

6.d: 特 very, especially; 异常 unusually; 较为 relatively (written).
6.vi: It's unusually cold today.

6.d: 净 all, nothing but; 一同 together; 大都 mostly.
6.zh: 来参加活动的大都是年轻人。
6.vi: Most of the people at the event were young.

6.c: 一时、不时、仍旧、依旧、一向
6.d: 一时 for a moment; 不时 now and then; 仍旧/依旧 still as before; 一向 always (so far).
6.vi: He has always been punctual.

6.d: 一再/再三: again and again.
6.zh: 老师再三提醒我们要注意安全。
6.vi: The teacher reminded us again and again to stay safe.

6.c: 不禁、赶忙、特地、特意、偷偷
6.d: 不禁 can't help; 赶忙 hurriedly; 特地/特意 specially; 偷偷 secretly.
6.vi: I came specially to see you.

6.d: 未必: not necessarily.
6.vi: Expensive things aren't necessarily good.

6.c: 恰好、倒是、干脆、明明、总算
6.d: 恰好 just right; 倒是 actually, on the other hand; 干脆 simply, flatly; 明明 obviously; 总算 at last.
6.vi: We finally got home.

6.d: 于 like 在 (written): at, in.
6.vi: He was born in 1990.

6.d: 至于: as for (changing the topic).
6.zh: 我只负责买票，至于住哪儿，你们决定吧。
6.vi: I'll just buy the tickets; as for where to stay, you decide.

6.d: 因 like 因为 (written): due to, because.
6.vi: The match was postponed because of rain.

6.d: 除 like 除了 (written): except, besides.
6.zh: 除星期一外，博物馆每天开放。
6.vi: Except on Mondays, the museum is open every day.

6.d: 不料: unexpectedly (starts the second clause).
6.zh: 我想出去玩，不料下起了大雨。
6.vi: I was going to go out, but unexpectedly it poured with rain.

6.d: 所 + verb + 的: what (someone does); (为/被)……所 + verb.
6.vi: This is the situation as I know it.

6.d: 啦 = 了 + 啊 (cheerful, urging); 嘛 stresses the obvious.
6.vi: If you have a question, just ask.

6.d: ……也好，……也好: either… or… is fine; or "it's good too".
6.zh: 你去也好，不去也好，都告诉我一声。
6.vi: Whether you go or not is fine, just let me know.

6.d: Doing something over and over: 问这问那 (ask about everything), 左思右想 (think it over and over).
6.zh: 他左思右想，还是决定去。
6.vi: He thought it over and over and still decided to go.

6.c: 好（不）容易、那倒（也）是、算了、得了
6.d: 好(不)容易 with great difficulty; 那倒(也)是 that's true; 算了 forget it; 得了 that's enough, OK.
6.vi: I finally managed to buy a ticket.

6.c: A一+量词，B一+量词；东一 A，西一 A；到……为 止；X到Y头上来了；不 X不……，一 X……；好你 个X；早（也）不 X，晚（也）不 X；看/瞧+把+宾语 （施事）+X得；放着 X不Y；X了就X了，（没）有……；这/那也不 X，那/这也不Y；X归X，Y归 Y；看你X的/瞧他 X的
6.d: 到……为止 until…; 东一A，西一A one… here, one… there; X归X，Y归Y; 早不X，晚不X; 看/瞧把……X得…
6.zh: 今天的课就讲到这里为止。
6.vi: That's all for today's lesson.

6.c: 程度补语3：动词/形容词+透+了
6.d: Verb/adjective + 透了: completely, utterly.
6.vi: This is utterly awful.

6.c: 把字句4：（1）主语（非生物体）+把+宾语+动词+其他 成分；（2）主语+把+宾语（施事）+动词+其他成分
6.d: Subject is an event + 把 + object + verb + other elements; or the person after 把 is the one affected.
6.vi: This made him worried sick.

6.d: 一时……一时……: one moment… the next….
6.vi: The weather is cold one moment, hot the next.

6.d: 要么……，要么……: either… or… (pick one).
6.vi: Either you come, or I go.

6.d: 虽 like 虽然 (written); the second clause uses 但/可/却/也.
6.vi: Although he's young, he's very experienced.

6.c: 凡是……，都……；除非……，才……；除非……，否 则/不然……
6.d: 凡是……都 every… all; 除非……才 only if…; 除非……否则/不然 unless… otherwise….
6.zh: 除非你去请他，否则他不会来。
6.vi: Unless you invite him, he won't come.

6.d: 就算……，也……: even if… still (spoken).
6.zh: 就算明天下雨，我们也要出发。
6.vi: Even if it rains tomorrow, we still have to set off.

6.d: ……，以便……: so that…
6.zh: 请留下电话，以便我们联系你。
6.vi: Please leave your phone number so we can contact you.

1.d: Subject + time + (adverb) + place + verb + object. Time can also come first in the sentence.

ex.vi: Today I'm studying Chinese at home.
In the evening I usually read at home.

1.d: 不 negates habits, the present, the future and wishes. 没 negates things that happened or existence.

2.t: 有点儿 vs 一点儿
2.d: 有点儿 goes before an adjective to express a feeling or judgement (often unwanted). 一点儿 goes after an adjective to ask for a change in degree.

2.t: 会 vs 能 vs 可以
2.d: 会: can (a learned skill), or "will". 能: have the ability or conditions. 可以: be allowed.

3.d: Don't use 把 just because there's an object. A 把 sentence stresses what is done to the object and needs a concrete result after the verb.

ex.vi: I closed the door. (not 我把门关。)
Put the book on the table. (not 请把书放。)

3.d: 再 (next time) / 又 (again, already happened); 才 (late) / 就 (early); 还是 (choice questions) / 或者 (statements); 二 (ordinal) / 两 (before measure words); 怎么 (manner) / 怎么样 (evaluation).

ex.vi: Would you like tea or coffee?

order.q: 我 / 今天 / 在家 / 学习
已经 / 做完 / 我 / 作业 / 了
比 / 妹妹 / 我 / 高
正在 / 他 / 公司 / 工作
如果 / 有时间 / 我 / 就 / 去
把 / 请 / 放在 / 书 / 桌子上
对 / 我 / 中文 / 感兴趣
越来越 / 天气 / 暖和
一边 / 她 / 一边 / 听音乐 / 做饭
order.a: 她一边听音乐，一边做饭。

order.q: 除了 / 中文 / 还 / 我 / 学习 / 英语
order.a: 除了中文，我还学习英语。

trans.q: I went to the supermarket yesterday.
My Chinese is getting better and better.
If I'm not busy tomorrow, I'll go for coffee with you.
trans.a: 如果我明天不忙，我就和你去喝咖啡。

trans.q: Besides Chinese, I also want to learn Korean.
trans.a: 除了中文以外，我还想学习韩语。

trans.q: Although I'm very tired today, I still want to study.
trans.a: 虽然今天很累，但是我还是想学习。

trans.q: Please put the book on the table.
I want to find a job where I can use Chinese.
trans.a: 我想找一份可以用中文的工作。

fix.why: 是 and 有 don't go together.
Use 没 for things that already happened.
Don't use 很 in 比 sentences.
The place goes before the verb.
The time goes before the verb.
Don't use 把 when there's no result of the action.

fix.q: 虽然很累，所以我还学习。
fix.a: 虽然很累，但是我还在学习。
fix.why: 虽然 pairs with 但是, not with 所以.
对…感兴趣, but 喜欢 takes the object directly.
Use V + 得 to comment on how something is done.

fix.q: 如果明天下雨，我也不去就。
fix.a: 如果明天下雨，我就不去了。
